profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX, with headquarters listed in Singapore. Its website describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site's material on artificial intelligence centers on data growth rather than a named AI product. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, that people and machines will create in more ways at a faster pace as AI proliferates, and that it is optimizing storage for AI to support data center architecture and buildout. It also points readers toward assessing their own readiness and developing a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth.

Beyond the company profile, no products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for Seagate. The profile carries a Central Index Key of 0001137789.
